model.title: A bill to establish the Grand Village of the Natchez Indians and Jefferson College as affiliated areas of the National Park System, and for other purposes.
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith (R-MS)

summary.text: The bill would establish the Grand Village of the Natchez Indians in Natchez, Mississippi, as an affiliated area of the National Park System. It would also designate Historic Jefferson College in Natchez as an affiliated area, pending the Department of the Interior's approval that the site meets the necessary criteria for such designation.
